name: Rockland Foodservice
old_description: We fill the gap between the big food distributors and the retail chains you are used to. We aim to Feed Maine (ME) by providing exemplary service and competitive prices.
about:
Since the 1980s, Rockland Foodservice has operated in Rockland, Maine, under the ownership of a local family. The business traces its roots to an earlier incarnation as Rockland Wholesale, which occupied a building now home to J. Edward Knight Insurance, and before that a location next door to where CarQuest Auto Parts now stands. The family also operated Shore Save, a former grocery store that once stood where a Rite Aid pharmacy is today.

The company runs a foodservice store just outside downtown Rockland, offering a wide variety of foodservice and drink items for takeaway. It sources from numerous local and out-of-state distributors and can procure specialty items usually within a few days. The operation handles bulk and party orders, allowing customers to place advance orders a week early for weddings, parties, or boat trips, with items set aside for pickup. Curbside service is also available.

Rockland Foodservice serves local restaurants, hotels, and individual customers throughout the Midcoast region. Its customer base includes anyone needing foodservice supplies, from professional kitchens to residents planning large gatherings.

The business was founded to fill the gap between large national food distributors and conventional retail chains, aiming to provide exemplary service and competitive prices to the Maine market. The company emphasizes a willingness to accommodate each customer, whether a first-time buyer or a long-time patron.

name: Rockler Woodworking and Hardware - Oklahoma City
old_description: For the best experience on our site, be sure to turn on Javascript in your browser.
about:
Rockler Woodworking and Hardware operates a retail location in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, serving the local woodworking community as part of a national chain. The store is situated on North May Avenue and maintains regular hours six days a week.

The store stocks a range of woodworking tools, hardware, and supplies, including Rockler-branded clamps, assembly squares, push blocks, glue application kits, dust collection components, and finishing products. It also carries brands such as Festool, Blum, Grass, SawStop, EZ Wood Tools, and Sorby. The location provides woodworking classes and workshops for all skill levels, supplying tools and materials for participants. Community events such as the Clamp Into Spring Event & Tool Swap feature free demonstrations, a tool swap, and specialty wood vendors.

The store serves hobbyist woodworkers, professional cabinetmakers, woodturners, and the broader maker community in central Oklahoma. Customers include individuals seeking tools for home shops, as well as attendees of hands-on classes and community events.

The company emphasizes hands-on education and community engagement, offering classes with all tools and materials provided, and hosting free demo events with local vendors. The location also carries exclusive Rockler-branded items and an expanded selection of drawer slides and finishing products.

name: Rockport Steel
old_description: Rockport Steel, located in Midcoast Maine, specializes in custom metal fabrication projects of all shapes and sizes. We believe everybody should have the ability to construct beautiful metal work.
about:
Rockport Steel operates from Rockport, Maine, on the state's Midcoast region. The company has been providing custom metal fabrication for over 30 years, beginning as a small boat-building operation with just a couple of employees. No founding year or founder names are disclosed.

Today the shop focuses on structural steel fabrication and custom architectural metalwork, offering forming, welding, cutting, consulting, technical drawings, and installation services. The team handles projects ranging from railings, stairs, fences, and gates to commercial signs, sculptures, docks, ramps, and boats, supported by 3D modeling and a boom truck for heavy placement.

The company serves both commercial and residential clients across construction, marine, architectural, and artistic sectors. Past work includes structural frameworks for buildings, custom railings for homes, marine docks and ramps, and large-scale sculptures.

Rockport Steel emphasizes superior quality and workmanship, aiming to exceed customer expectations through custom design collaboration that brings client ideas to life.

name: Rogue Welding & Fabrication
old_description: In 2024, we proudly introduced our CNC plasma cutting table, enabling us to take our custom fabrication capabilities to the next level.
about:
Rogue Welding & Fabrication operates from Gardiner, Maine, where owner Devon Sproul established the business after nearly a decade of professional fabrication experience. Sproul’s background spans corporate industrial welding and small business metal repair, giving him a breadth of skill that now underpins the company’s work.

The shop provides stick, MIG, and AC/DC TIG welding alongside CNC plasma cutting, which was added in 2024. A portable engine-driven rig enables mobile welding across Maine, while the Gardiner facility off Route 201 handles in-shop projects of any scale. Services also include custom design, on-site planning, and fabrication of items such as personalized signs, fire pits, and specialty metal parts in aluminum, stainless steel, and carbon steel.

Customers range from homeowners needing garage or home items to commercial operators outfitting work trailers and fishing vessels. Past clients include East Coast Recovery & Towing, a towing company, and The Mad Tinter, along with individual repairs such as snowmobile trailers. The company serves industrial, marine, automotive, and residential sectors through both mobile and in-shop work.

Sproul states the business is dedicated to providing a professional experience and quality work on every job, emphasizing the ability to turn a client’s vision into reality with precision and efficiency.

name: Rohrer Corporation
old_description: Rohrer Corporation Expands Sustainable Material Options In Its ezCombo® Packaging Program
about:
Rohrer Corporation was founded in 1973 by brothers John and David Rohrer in Warwick, Rhode Island. The company remained family-led until 2021, when private equity firm Wellspring Capital Management acquired the business. Over the decades, Rohrer expanded through strategic acquisitions, adding CardPak in 2016, Transparent Container in 2018, Coburn Carton in 2021, and Jay Packaging in 2022. Today it operates nine regional facilities across the United States and Mexico, with its headquarters in Warwick, RI.

The company provides end-to-end retail packaging solutions, spanning design and engineering, printing and thermoforming, tooling and machinery, and technical service assistance. Its manufacturing footprint includes capabilities such as soft-touch coating and production tooling, supported by equipment like X-Rite color management scanners. Rohrer runs programs like ezCombo® and ecoCombo® that focus on sustainable material options, including post-consumer recycled content and FSC-certified substrates.

Rohrer serves the medical and pharmaceutical packaging sector, as well as cosmetic and consumer-goods brands. Its customer roster includes Newell Brands (Sharpie Spinner Pack), Mars Fishcare, The Haus, Lumi, and CE Tools. The company emphasizes collaborative engineering support to bring packaging concepts to production.

Rohrer positions itself on speed, quality, and sustainability. It targets zero defects and 100% on-time delivery, backed by ISO 9001:2015, FSC Chain of Custody, and GMI full certification. The firm’s stated differentiators include its ezCombo® program for rapid access to sustainable materials, a nine-facility network for regional responsiveness, and color-consistency systems such as PantoneLIVE.

name: Royal Automation & Controls
old_description: We carry all the top manufacturers and brands in the business
about:
Royal Automation & Controls operates in Salt Lake City, Utah, and has served the Wasatch Front since 1957. The branch is part of Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED), a national network with more than 700 locations, and functions as a wholesale supplier of electrical equipment and automation solutions.

The company stocks a broad range of industrial controls and automation hardware, including variable-frequency drives, PLCs, SCADA platforms, explosion-proof enclosures, push buttons, and switchgear. It provides VFD programming and start-up commissioning, switchgear and lighting quotations, project management support, and a delivery service for local customers. Inventory is maintained on-site to support same-day or next-day fulfillment for contractors and panel builders.

Customers span industrial and agricultural contractors, OEMs, panel builders, system integrators, and municipal water and wastewater facilities. The branch also serves the mining, metals, and minerals sector and the oil and gas industry across the Intermountain region. Its sales team works directly with electrical contractors and facility maintenance departments on both new construction and MRO projects.

Royal Automation & Controls emphasizes its role as a single-source partner anchored by a long-standing relationship with Schneider Electric, carrying the full Altivar drive lineup, Square D switchgear, and Harmony operator interfaces. A dedicated industrial sales staff, rapid response times, and local delivery are cited as the primary reasons contractors rely on the branch for day-to-day and project-critical needs.

name: Rubicon Automotive Group
old_description: Founded by George Roeske, Rubicon Automotive Group is a dream that started as a college business plan in 2004 and then became a reality in the summer of 2018.
about:
Rubicon Automotive Group operates from Grants Pass, Oregon.

The business sells quality recycled auto parts, including wheels, truck beds, gates, and powertrain accessories, sourced from repairable OEM wheels and take-off parts it purchases directly. Inventory is listed on eBay and Car-Part platforms, with thousands of wheels in stock. Orders are typically processed and shipped within one business day.

Customers include automotive repair shops, individual vehicle owners, and mechanics seeking replacement wheels and parts for all makes and models. The company serves the automotive recycling and aftermarket distribution sectors, providing interchange assistance to ensure the correct part is delivered the first time.

Roeske started Rubicon to embed a philosophy of honesty, integrity, and attention to detail into every transaction. The company emphasizes transparency in part identification, accessibility via phone, email, and chat, and continuous innovation in processes that create value for customers.
